title: Straw Bed Fix
body:
# 💥Straw Beds Can Now Explode!

Starting from snapshot **26.3-snapshot-3**, Mojang added **Straw Beds**. By default, if you try to use them in the Nether or the End, they just quietly disappear. This mod fixes that and brings back the iconic bed explosion!

---

### ✨ Features
* 🎮 **Works Everywhere:** Works perfectly fine both in singleplayer worlds and on multiplayer servers!
* 🖥️ **Server-Side Only:** For multiplayer, you only need to install this mod on the **server**! Clients (players) can join with a completely vanilla snapshot client, and everything will work perfectly for them.
